Name: The Big Garage Conversion (CP or AT)
Author: Cedarwood7916
Description:
This mod is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41168370]HopeWasHere[/url]'s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/906]The Big Garage[/url]. I really liked the sprites, and me and others in that mod's comments were struggling with it, because it works with XNB files. I got those switched to PNG and threw them into a simple CP script, so that you can use the mod without messing with XNB files. 

AT version thrown together by Fuzzbop (thanks for that)
